combo_label: The Office × Mushrooms & Foraging × Heists & Capers

entries.clue: Kidnappers' asking price, payable in unmarked bills
Combination-dial strongbox that film cracksmen open with a stethoscope
Steel-doored room the whole plan revolves around
Rollers that seal a notice in hot plastic so it survives the staff kitchen
Line of mixed shrubs marking an old field boundary, a free larder in autumn
Salty green shoot cut from a tidal mud flat and served beside grilled fish
Shared perch claimed each morning by whoever books it first on an app
Scarlet fruit left on the briar after the flowers, boiled into a vitamin C syrup
Short internal bulletin sent round to all staff, ancestor of the group email
Written record of who said what, signed off as accurate at the next session
Garlic-scented leaves carpeting a damp April wood; the arum among them burns
